decisions.reason: As a heavily developed successor to an already accepted screening machine, it carries prior investment and installed-market legitimacy, so management would likely keep it and treat any slower momentum as temporary.

This multi-model mobile shredder line was publicly refreshed for Stage V and fits the firm's core mobile recycling portfolio, making management inclined to continue rather than retreat after such visible commitment.

Although the evidence of market traction is less explicit than for some other lines, it is still a multi-model core processing product, so sunk development costs and strategic fit would push management to keep it on the market.

The firm has made a strong public claim that the new CERON generation sets standards in its segment, and because it is central to tougher stationary processing solutions, management would be very reluctant to withdraw it quickly.
